about: Generated imagery for the My Dealer (mydealermn.com) redesign pitch, version 3, design 'Lake Country' (glassmorphism x Minnesota lake country). Run: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project>. Every result is AI-generated and illustrative: never a picture of My Dealer's store, staff, customers or products, and the lake is a generic mood, never a real place. g- ids are editorial product still lifes at blue hour (weathered dock and cabin wood, pine, birch, wool, speckled blue camp enamelware, banded agate pebbles, a calm lake and pine shoreline blurred behind, a warm lantern accent), subject right of centre with calm space on the left for hero text; g-smoke is kept from version 1. s- ids are wordless black-ink engravings with near mirror symmetry and lake-country accents (pine boughs, a small four-point north star, water ripple lines) on pure white; the three tall ones are generated at 3:4 and cropped to 4:5 after a paper clean-up (tmp/img/sketch-post-v3.py).

defaults.style: no people, no hands, no faces, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no brand marks, all surfaces blank and unmarked
